rationale: Description: 'Puddle of hydraulic fluid forming under the main reservoir.' (Requires inferring fluid leaks are mechanical/fluid-power issues).
Description: 'Drive unit trips after 20 minutes of operation. Motor casing unusually hot.' (Tripping and heat imply electrical overload).
Description: 'SCADA screen showing erratic jumping values for cooling water flow, but physical flow looks steady.' (Points to a faulty sensor/transmitter, not the physical pump).
Description: 'Loud whining noise coming from the drive end of the conveyor.' (Whining at a drive end implies bearing or gearbox mechanical failure).
Description: 'Acrid burning smell near the MCC panel when Line 2 starts.' (Burning smell near a control center is a classic electrical fault).
Description: 'Press won't reach full tonnage. Drifts down when held under load.' (Implies a mechanical/hydraulic bypass or seal leak).
Description: 'Robot arm moving past its home limit switch without stopping.' (Limit switch failure is an instrumentation/control issue).
Description: 'Air line hissing near the packaging cell.' (Pneumatic leaks typically route to general/facilities unless severe).
